title: The conformation of the complementary strand and the deformation of the DNA groove upon DDB2 binding justifies the different repair rates for cyclobutane pyrimidine dimers.
authors: Kedjar, Yani; Hognon, Cecilia; Douki, Thierry; Dumont, Elise; Monari, Antonio
journal: Photochemical & photobiological sciences : Official journal of the European Photochemistry Association and the European Society for Photobiology
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子分子动力学模拟研究DDB2蛋白识别不同环丁烷嘧啶二聚体DNA损伤时互补链与DNA沟槽的构象变形，属蛋白质-DNA互作机制建模，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合研究。
abstract: The repair of photo-induced DNA lesions through nucleotide excision repair machinery is still the source of important questions. It has been observed that the repair rate of the different cyclobutane pyrimidine dimers, i.e. the photoproducts induced by dimerization of two pi-stacked pyrimidines (T < > T, T < > C, C < > T, C < > C), depends on the nucleobases involved in the lesion. TT derivatives (T < > T) are removed more slowly than those containing cytosine, especially in 5'. Using all-atom molecular dynamics simulations, we demonstrate that the variation of the repair rate observed in human skin and in cultured cutaneous cell may be associated to the recognition of the four lesions by the DDB2 protein moiety, and more specifically by the differential structural deformation induced on the complementary strand and the major groove. These effects may then hamper differentially the downstream recruitment of the repair complexes. The observed DNA deformation correlates with the experimental repair rate and suggests a structural rationale for the different repair rates of CPD by nucleotide excision repair machinery.
abstract_zh: 通过核苷酸切除修复机制修复光诱导DNA损伤仍是重要问题的来源。已观察到不同环丁烷嘧啶二聚体，即由两个π-堆叠嘧啶二聚化诱导的光产物（T < > T、T < > C、C < > T、C < > C）的修复速率，取决于损伤中涉及的核碱基。含胸腺嘧啶的衍生物（T < > T）比含胞嘧啶的移除更慢，尤其是在5'端。利用全原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，我们证明在人皮肤和培养皮肤细胞中观察到的修复速率变化可能与DDB2蛋白部分对四种损伤的识别有关，更具体地，与互补链和主要沟上诱导的差异结构变形相关。这些效应可能随后差异性地阻碍修复复合物的下游招募。观察到的DNA变形与实验修复速率相关，并为核苷酸切除修复机制对CPD不同修复速率提供了结构上的解释。
